authority.title: Computing Apparent Planetary Magnitudes for The Astronomical Almanac
authority.qualification: V-band phase equations transcribed from equations 2 through 17. Distance, rotation, season, latitude, and ring terms cancel or are held fixed so each curve isolates phase-angle dependence.

qualification: The greater-than-12-degree Cassini branch is limited to 130 degrees because the source paper reports no constraining data beyond that angle.
